Docs.summary: Endpoint-mapping extensions that expose a Microsoft 365 Agents SDK AgentApplication over the Foundry Activity protocol. These are the Foundry counterpart to the SDK's MapAgentApplicationEndpoints: an existing Microsoft 365 agent converts to a Foundry hosted agent by swapping MapAgentApplicationEndpoints(...) for MapFoundryActivity().

Docs.summary: Maps the Foundry Activity protocol endpoint (POST /activity/messages) onto an existing endpoint route builder, routing each request to the supplied instead of the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK adapter. Use this to own the request pipeline in a self-hosted app while still getting the Foundry platform contract (session-id response header, correlation baggage, and error-source classification). The Microsoft 365 Agents SDK is not used on this path.
Docs.returns: The endpoint route builder, for chaining.
